tweets.text:
Another major drug bust through Operation Pacific Viper. 

The crew of #USCG Cutter Tampa interdicted a go-fast vessel deep in the Eastern Pacific, seizing 1,925 kilograms of cocaine worth an estimated $31.9M. 

Since launching Operation Pacific Viper in early August, we’ve interdicted over 200K lbs of cocaine. As significant transport of illicit narcotics continues from South and Central America, our maritime fighting force remains focused on countering narco-terrorism and protecting the homeland.   

#SemperParatus

tweets.text:
Crisis leadership at its most urgent. 

As America’s maritime first responder, the Coast Guard is Always Ready for the call. 

On Tuesday morning, when a barge caught fire on Delaware Bay, our men and women from Coast Guard Cutter Sector Delaware Bay responded – working with local emergency responders and partner agencies to establish a safety zone, issue a Broadcast Notice to Mariners, and mitigate the risks additional fires.   

Responding to crisis and contingency is a Coast Guard core mission, through which we fulfill our sacred trust to save lives every day.  
 
Read more at: https://t.co/xUuUV0CHuG 

#CoastGuard #DelawareBay

tweets.text:
Defending America through Operation Pacific Viper.  

The crew of #USCG Cutter Forward, with an embarked Helicopter Interdiction Tactical Squadron (HITRON) team, interdicted a drug-smuggling self-propelled semi-submersible (SPSS) in the Eastern Pacific. Though the SPSS sank after its four crew were apprehended, this interdiction prevented an estimated 17,600 pounds of cocaine – more than 6 million potentially lethal doses – from reaching our shores.  

Bravo Zulu to Cutter Forward and HITRON crews, who continue our operations to counter narco-terrorists and secure U.S. borders and maritime approaches.  

Read more from @USCGSouthwest here: https://t.co/EiIivYo99G

tweets.text:
Welcome home, CGC Munro!

After a historic 119-day, 26,000-mile patrol, the Munro’s crew returned to Alameda, California following the single largest maritime drug seizure in 18 years.

Through Operation Pacific Viper, they interdicted over 22,000 lbs of cocaine worth an estimated $250M, a record for our HITRON teams that keeps drugs off our streets. Spearheading the nation’s efforts to interdict dark fleet oil tankers, CGC Munro’s shadowed the Motor Tanker Bella 1 across the Atlantic, culminating in the vessel’s seizure.

Unmatched impact in defense of America by a dedicated crew. Read more: https://t.co/wDSjjv7Jr1

tweets.text:
Carving a path through the Antarctic ice.

#USCG Cutter Polar Star is on station for Operation Deep Freeze, clearing the way for vital resupply ships to reach McMurdo Station.

Ever wonder how we navigate the ice so efficiently? The Coast Guard is accelerating our use of advanced robotic and autonomous systems, like the SkyDio X10D, to survey ice conditions, enhancing safety, vigilance, and mission effectiveness.

In some of the world’s most challenging environments, like the Antarctic, we’re unifying vigilance and innovation to empower our crews and secure U.S. interests.

@DHSgov @USCGPACAREA 

#SemperParatus
